about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Backend Developer with a passion for scalable systems
about.description:
I'm Salim Vazquez Solis, a seasoned backend developer with over 3 years of experience building high-performance, scalable systems for startups and enterprise clients.
With a strong foundation in computer science and a deep understanding of distributed systems, I've successfully led teams to deliver complex backend solutions that handle millions of requests daily.
 I'm passionate about clean code, performance optimization, and implementing best practices for security and reliability.
